summary: Phase 149O.20L.7D.9 -- Repaired-Source Redeployment + Action-9 Invocation Amendment Proposition. Proposition/authority-capture only (no Dell mutation, no venv reinstall, no wrapper change, no Mac source mutation, no Action-9 rerun as adjudication, no DeploymentBinding, no certification, no activation). Independently re-validated candidate source SHA 28bf137b5dc95d024e8913b678dce0501a46fd0f: despite a misleading commit subject naming an unrelated finalization-gate literal repair, git merge-base --is-ancestor proves it contains 7D.7's actual repair commit 73ea8b23; zero authority-relevant drift after it (only governance/doc/task files changed); contract versions HBDC-001 v1.0/HMIC-001 v1.3/HMRC-001 v1.1 unchanged across the entire old-deployed-to-candidate span; implementation_scope_digest independently recomputed via disposable git worktrees (candidate 4e3452ba..., old-deployed b728d368...), matching 7D.8's own reported values exactly. Live, read-only Dell reverification (before and after CHGR publication) found zero drift from the 7D.8 baseline: source pinned at 7a3fa971..., detached, clean, 4030-path mode mapping intact; wrapper digest b3e969...c32 unchanged; zero DeploymentBinding anywhere. Editable-install inspection (.pth content is a path, direct_url.json's url is a path, neither is a SHA/hash) independently classified NO VENV MUTATION REQUIRED. Chose update-in-place redeployment (fetch + detached checkout at the existing path, re-applying 7D.3/7D.5's own mode-mapping discipline against the candidate's own freshly-enumerated inventory) over staged replacement; exact literal forward/read-back/rollback commands materialized using both full 40-character SHAs, no placeholders; rollback proven network-independent (the old SHA is the checkout's own current HEAD, structurally guaranteed locally reachable). Corrected Action-9 PATH (/opt/pcae/runtime/venv/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin) independently re-derived from normative environment-lock semantics and live-reconfirmed sufficient via read-only which diagnostics -- explicitly labeled non-authoritative, not an adjudication attempt. Explicit HMIC implementation/source-identity-changed, contract-identity-unchanged, NOT-CERTIFIED-FOR-BOUNDARY-C disclosure. Independently confirmed neither prior CHGR (chgr-96a0ce12756e4cc892492a87af1db832, published 2026-08-15T04:20:10Z; chgr-541cb08c313b4f8884970172d37c5a1d, published 2026-08-15T07:54:39Z) authorizes this source-identity transition or PATH amendment, read directly from each record's own text and publish timestamp. Full 745-line proposition materialized (docs/PHASE_149O_20L_7D_9_...md) with a full exclusion list (no DeploymentBinding, Boundary C/A, Cutover Record, Permission Broker/POL-005/COMP-002, repository onboarding, centralization, venv/wrapper mutation, HMIC certification, or execution). Presented for genuine human election with no default and no inferred selection; human elected APPROVE, then gave a separate, explicit confirmation statement (not inferred from the election). Captured via three pcae decision-session cycles -- the first two abandoned cleanly before reaching a published CHGR (one used an unregistered template-ref causing an advisory authority_evaluation_stage_1 evaluation_failed and a readiness internal_error; the second's decision_subject exceeded the CHGR-001 schema's 500-character limit) -- the third, using the pre-existing registered class-b-boundary-p-provisioning-authorization/1.0 template and a trimmed subject line, completed create/evidence/select/preview/confirm/readiness/publish cleanly and published chgr-0e37ed1340b14311826722c4dbf3e856, independently inspected and structurally verified (schema_shape, digest_self_consistency, lifecycle_structural_legality all passed). Zero Dell mutation confirmed live, both before this phase began and immediately after CHGR publication (source SHA and wrapper digest re-read via a fresh SSH command, unchanged). Companion test module (independently authored, does not import any other phase's test module): 49 passed, 0 failed. Expected future residual after real redeployment + PATH amendment lands: exactly {HBDC-REQ-042}; any other outcome must STOP for read-only adjudication, not be treated as success. Recommends 149O.20L.7D.10 (independent authorization verification, still no real Dell mutation) next; 7E remains blocked.
